FAQs

Questions Clients Often Ask

What are your prices?

Our prices vary greatly depending on the scope of the work. They typically start from $500 per video.

Do I need to commit to a retainer?

Nope! While we do offer ongoing services, we'd also love to work on one-off projects for you.

Do you work with international clients?

Yes! We work with clients from around the world.

How do I pay you for your service?

After our discovery call, you'll receive a proposal with a custom quote. You can choose to either pay it in full or via 2 installments.
